overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals granted variances for residential projects on South Street and Riverside Avenue, approved an extension for a mixed-use development on Boston Avenue, and continued hearings for 55 Burgett Avenue and 7 Summer Street.

items.title: 55 Burgett Avenue
items.summary: Continued to the January 26, 2023 meeting at the applicant's request.

items.title: 54 South Street
items.summary: The applicant withdrew the application without prejudice as of right following the board's prior determination regarding frontage variance requirements.

items.title: 590 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved a six-month extension of the variance and special permit for the demolition of a gas station and construction of a 40-unit residential building with retail space.

items.title: 71 South Street
items.summary: Approved variances for building height and number of stories to construct an additional story on an existing single-family dwelling, following a formal finding that the expansion is not substantially more detrimental to the neighborhood.

items.title: 7 Summer Street
items.summary: Continued the petition for a special permit to install a driveway with reduced setback after the board requested engineering and traffic departments review curb cut dimensions and pedestrian safety.

items.title: 187 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved variances to construct a 20-by-23-foot detached garage within the side yard setback and six feet from the primary dwelling.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the December meeting as amended.
